name: SWECOV
description: SWECOV, the Swedish COVID-19 research data infrastructure, is a research database of Swedish register data held on MONA at Statistics Sweden. Browse the register variables SWECOV holds, with their definitions and the years they cover, and collect the ones you need into a project to order.
order_instructions: To order data, email your project_data.json to your SWECOV coordinator. They review the project and generate order.json from it, so you do not need to download or send order.json.
